environment.description: Same service deployed on EKS 1.28 with Istio 1.20 service mesh. The payment-workflow pod runs in namespace 'payment-processing'. An Istio AuthorizationPolicy resource named 'deny-cross-ns-session-init' is applied at mesh level with spec.rules matching source.notNamespaces=['payment-processing'] for paths ['/api/workflow/init', '/api/workflow/authorize-payment'] with custom action DENY. Additionally, a RequestAuthentication policy requires JWT tokens issued by the internal OIDC provider (issuer: https://oidc.internal.corp/realms/payments) on all paths matching /api/*, and the AuthorizationPolicy 'require-jwt-claims' enforces that request.auth.claims[sub] must match the X-User-Id header via a CUSTOM action Wasm plugin (envoy.filters.http.lua inline). The /internal/* paths are restricted to source.principals matching 'cluster.local/ns/step-functions-runner/sa/sfn-task-runner' only.

config.service_mesh: Istio 1.20.2 with strict mTLS PERMISSIVE on port 8080 for health checks only, STRICT on all other ports
config.wasm_plugin: envoy.filters.http.lua validates X-User-Id matches JWT sub claim before forwarding
